Removes Drive Assist, its helper and the CAN reader, and gives the car\'s own lock sound back. It touches only our own things, never another app. The deep root from recovery stays.
Stop services and wipe Drive Assist\'s data
Remove Drive Assist and its helper (keep ADB on)
Remove and close ADB (before a workshop visit)

Close ADB only before a workshop visit. It turns off how Drive Assist reaches the car, and nothing is left on the car to re-open it. To use Drive Assist again, unlock the car the same way you did the first time.
Nothing done yet.\nEvery button asks for confirmation (tap twice).
Services stopped, icons removed, alarm canceled and data wiped.\nDrive Assist is still installed, but inert.
The helper is missing, so the CAN reader and ADB can\'t be cleaned from here. Removing Drive Assist only.
Removing Drive Assist and its helper…
Connects to the broker and sends vehicle telemetry to Home Assistant.
No valid certificate files found on USB drive
The cover fills the card, with big Play and Skip buttons.
Sends the song, artist and album to lrclib.net to find the lyrics. Off: nothing is sent.
Shows what your phone plays in the car, from any app.
No room for the lyrics: other cards are using the screen.
No lyrics found for this song.
When off, the car ignores charging and light commands coming from Home Assistant.
Closed. When open, network ADB access is enabled.
Open — closes on its own in %1$d min.

Only for apps that need ADB, such as GeelyTelemetry (Capy). ADB then never closes on its own. Anyone on the same Wi-Fi network can take full control of the head unit. Leave this off unless you need it.
ModeHelper is not installed, so nothing here can turn ADB on or off.
Keeps ADB active and prevents screen timeout on this network.
The app turns Wi-Fi back on when it goes off. Needed for MQTT, updates and Home Assistant.
The app leaves Wi-Fi alone. While Wi-Fi is off, MQTT and updates stop.
Crack the window when the door opens
Lowers window slightly when door opens to ease closing, then raises it when shut.
Normal sound (when combustion mode is off)
Imported. It plays on the next lock.
No LockChime.wav found at the top of the USB stick.
The file is bigger than 1 MB. Shorten it or save it as mono.
That is not a WAV file.
Import a sound first: from USB or from a link.

Plays when you lock the car with the key. Custom sound: a WAV file of 1 MB or less, named LockChime.wav at the top of a USB stick, or a link. It plays over the sound picked in the car\'s own Settings. Picking another sound there, or Car\'s sound, gives back the car\'s own sound.
Could not reach the car\'s system shell. Try again.
Needs a newer ModeHelper. Update it in Config > System.

How far each window lowers when you press the crack-windows button. 0 = closed, 100 = fully open. The same number doesn\'t move every window the same real amount — tune each one to match what you actually see.

Learn mode: when you change the climate by hand on the car\'s panel and keep it for 10 minutes, it is counted. Once a week, with the climate off, each level takes the setting you kept most often (at least 2 times). Only for that outside temperature. Off: the ruler keeps what it learned and stops learning.
This week: %1$d hand changes counted. Next update: %2$s.
Everything the ruler learned is deleted. The standard ruler comes back.
Regen button steps through Low, Medium and High

Drive Assist puts your saved choice back when the car starts. Drive mode and regeneration come back in Park, until they match or you pick another one in the car. AEB and AVAS come back in the first 15 seconds. After that, changes made in the car or in another app stay for the trip. Turn off a setting that another app already restores.
Disables automatic emergency braking. It stays off after a restart while Restore at car start is on for AEB (Advanced, below).
Could not connect to the car
Current mode unknown — pick one to apply
Shown on charging costs and statistics.
Auto follows this head unit\'s own day/night setting. Neon and Noturno always use their one fixed color scheme, whatever this is set to.
Detected from the car on first start. Change it here anytime.

In its hours, when the car is in dark mode and you drive for a minute without touching the screen, Darkest mode dims the screen to its lowest light. Darkness makes it even darker, with a dark layer on top: 0 % is the lowest light only, 100 % turns the screen off. Touch the screen or change gear to bring the light back. The first touch only lights the screen. Your car\'s brightness setting does not change.
Applies to every Drive Assist screen. The thumbnail shows the color and the shape of the cards — the change is immediate.
This theme lets a button tap flash the cabin\'s live ambient light color.
This theme ignores the cabin light on purpose — button taps flash amber instead.
Gunmetal gray by night, ivory by day
No held clips. Tap Hold on a clip first, or use its USB button.
%1$d clip(s) copied to USB: Drive Assist/Dashcam
Not enough free space on the USB stick
Copy to USB failed. Check the stick and try again.
Recovered — the clip is playable now
Connected — reading real power from the battery
Reads live battery data from a paired Bluetooth OBD2 dongle instead of vehicle estimates.
When off, ABRP uses your phone\'s location instead of vehicle GPS.
Sending a test ping to ABRP…
Test sent. Confirm connection in ABRP.
No charge in this period saved its place.
Samples are no longer available for this session.
No battery-temperature data for this session — the OBD2 dongle wasn\'t connected.
Drive Assist is up to date (%1$s)
Updates can only be reviewed and installed while parked.
The colours follow your own driving. Your driving days are split into five groups of 20% each, so the darkest colour is the 20% of days when you drove the most.

Saves your settings, trips and MQTT certificates to the USB stick and to the car storage, locked with your backup password. It also runs by itself once a day, in Park. A backup on the car storage stays when you delete the app. A backup on the USB stick also stays after a workshop reset. To restore after you delete the app, you need the backup password.
No backup found. Put in the USB stick that has the \"Drive Assist/Backups\" folder.
Restore the backup from %1$s?\n\nYour settings change to the ones in the backup. The trips in the backup are added to the trips on the car. Then the app restarts.
Put the car in P first.
Drive Assist found a backup from %1$s.\n\nIt brings back your settings, your trips and your MQTT certificates.
Backup restored: %1$d settings. The trips were already on the car.
No backup password yet, so backups are off. Tap Password to turn them on.
Write it down. Without it, nobody can open your backups.
Older backups keep the old password.
The 2 passwords are not the same.
Type the password of the backup from %1$s.
Read battery power from the car (CAN)

Exact battery volts × amps from the car itself. On by default; nothing to set up. It needs the ModeHelper app. To start its reader, it may switch ADB on for a few seconds, then off again. If it does not work, the app falls back to the dongle or to the battery % estimate. While it is on, other apps on the car can also read this car data.
Saves where each trip went and where each charge was. It stays in the car: nothing is sent anywhere. It goes into your backup. Trips from before this setting have no route.
No route for this trip. Routes are saved for trips driven with Config → System → Trip routes on.
No routes yet. Routes are saved for trips driven with Config → System → Trip routes on.
Touch a route or a trip to select it.

Average: the distance driven divided by the time the car was moving. Stops (traffic lights, waiting in Drive) do not count, so it is higher than the distance divided by the whole trip time.\n\nTop: the highest speed recorded on this trip.
Shows on new trips measured by CAN
Services and devices Drive Assist talks to. Tap one to set it up.
Send car data over MQTT and take commands.
Battery power and temperature from a Bluetooth dongle.
Live data for A Better Route Planner.
Your phone\'s music and lyrics, on the home screen.
Better text in the car\'s own apps.
Better text in the car\'s Energy, Wi-Fi, Settings and Permissions apps. Remove brings the factory text back.
Off. The car\'s apps show their factory text.
Waits for Park: the car\'s apps restart while it applies.
Failed: could not download the text. Check the internet connection.
The car\'s apps are not the ones the text was made for. Nothing was changed.
No route was saved in this time. Routes are saved with Config → System → Trip routes on.

Open a page on your phone to download trips, charges, backups and dashcam clips, restore a backup, and type long settings such as tokens. The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as the car. It works only in Park.
The page runs only while the QR code is on the screen.
The page also runs while the car is on the home Wi-Fi (set under Wi-Fi and ADB).
The page runs whenever the car is on a network. Only phones that scanned the QR code can use it.
Done. Every phone must scan the QR code again.
The car is not on Wi-Fi. Connect it to Wi-Fi first.
Your phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as the car. The page stays open while this code is on the screen.
CSV files. They open in any spreadsheet.
Maintenance history, ownership costs, and 5s incident clips.
The file is locked with your backup password.

Pick a .dabackup file. Your settings change to the ones in the backup. The trips in the backup are added to the trips on the car. Then the app on the car restarts. ADB, phone access, commands from Home Assistant and the backup password are not changed from here: they stay as they are on the car.
Empty if it is the password set on this car
Restoring. When it is done, the app on the car restarts and shows the result. Then this page stops.
This backup has another password. Type its password and try again.
Newest first. Big files: download on Wi-Fi.
Type tokens, addresses and passwords with your phone keyboard.
Empty fields stay as they are. To clear a setting, use the screen in the car.
The page is closed. Show the QR code on the car again.
Scan the QR code on the car screen again (Settings, System, Phone access).
The car is not in Park. The page works only in Park.
No backup yet. Make one on the car: Settings, System, Backup.
The car does not have enough free space for this file.
Your trips as GPX files. They open in Google Earth, Google My Maps and most map apps.
No trip with a recorded route yet.
No battery data in this period
Measured inside the battery and read through the OBD2 dongle. Only the time the dongle was connected counts.

No OBD2 dongle in this period, so these are the outside air temperatures the car reads, not the battery\'s. While charging and driving, the battery runs warmer than the air. Connect an OBD2 dongle to read the battery itself.
360 cameras: not fitted. The dashcam needs them, so it is off.
360 cameras: not read yet. The dashcam stays off until the car answers.

If this is wrong, send these lines in a GitHub issue.
No diary entries yet. Tap + Add entry to log maintenance, noises, or incidents.
Log charging or maintenance costs to track your cost per km.

HV LFP battery: occasional charges to 100% keep the BMS calibrated, while avoiding prolonged heat at 100% or sitting below 20% preserves long-term capacity.\n\n12V battery: resting voltage before ready mode should stay at or above 12.4 V. Below 12.2 V signals a weakening battery.
Each deadline counts from your last logged entry; Off hides the item.
Above 10 km/h, a hard jolt queues an incident note with an optional dashcam clip.
Log or dismiss jolts to see their G-force here and tune the threshold.
No trips recorded in this period.
No trips or charges recorded in this period.
No routes recorded in this period.
